name: Indian Hotels

snapshot.about: Indian hospitality company operating luxury, select service hotels, resorts, and catering businesses.

narrative: Management delivered on FY26 revenue growth targets with reported 16% growth versus double-digit guidance. Operating revenue grew 21.7% to ₹2,484 crore in Q2 FY27. However, expected FY27 hotel openings were scaled down to 50 from the earlier target of 60-plus.

promises.statement: IHCL expects 60-plus hotel openings across brands and geographies in FY27.

said.quote: In conclusion, in FY '27, we expect 60-plus hotel openings across brands and geographies

actual_source.quote: That means 30 hotels are expected to open in the second half of this year

promises.note: Management revised FY27 expected hotel openings downward to 50 total openings.

said.quote: Collectively these levers give us confidence in delivering double digit revenue growth in FY’26 and FY’27
